travelSpeedKmh.note: per-vehicle average speed through the interior arterials (trips >= 20 s), see docs/TRAFFIC_REALISM.md

rush.required: >= 2 approaches with a persisted queue of >= 8 vehicles and >= 50 m
>= 20 distinct motor vehicles with >= 2 stops and >= 2 starts

severe.required: >= 120 s with two consecutive blocks of one corridor each >= 75% queued AND a green-blocked movement between them
final-60 s density >= 80% of first-60 s
>= 20 distinct motor vehicles with >= 2 stops and >= 2 starts

gridlock.required: blocked directed cycle through >= 4 junctions across >= 2 corridors for >= 120 s
each cycle junction shows green-blocked movements (signals keep cycling)
outflow across the declared component <= 10% of its matched nonlocked reference
automatic deadlock rescue (teleport) disabled and disclosed for the observation

safety.required: zero native vehicle/vehicle and vehicle/person collision records, warm-up included
zero invalid active routes (sampled every 10 s)
integer demand ledger reconciles (no unexplained vehicles)
density >= 85 at t=0 and throughout the last two signal cycles of the warm-up

classification.note: Achieved class is measured; a slider position, a refused insertion or a screenshot never qualifies a tier.

ledger.note: discardedDerived is added - departed - pending; it must equal what SUMO logged. Non-zero residual = unexplained vehicles.

native.definition: An episode starts when a pair/type is reported after an unreported step; not a count of unique physical crashes.
